title: 第九章：晨练，那是我的秘密
content_zh:
虽然直觉告诉自己，老是做同一个噩梦不是一个什么好的兆头，但思来想去的也是想不出什么头绪，更何况，就算不是什么好事，那不还没发生吗？对这些没影儿的事，也没必要自己吓自己。

    不得不说，有时候推动人们前进脚步的，并不都是“人定胜天”这样的名言，例如我们的贺家大少爷，战胜未知困难的法宝就是“车到山前必有路”、“兵来将挡，水来土屯”等等一系列的警句。

    想完了该想的，抛开了不该想，漫漫长夜，万籁俱静，对于一个少爷来说，此情此景，不用来睡觉，实在是想不出要干些什么了。不过，好在虽然做了两次同样的噩梦，但也并不是一睡着就会做噩梦。

    毫无疑问，一个良好的睡眠，不仅可以消除昨日所有的疲劳，而且能够为新的一天带来一个好的心情。

    “少爷，你身上可还有伤呢，怎么有起那么早啊？”月儿满是幽怨的看着已经穿戴整齐的少爷，抿着嘴，小脸涨得通红，她觉得自己真的是越来越不称职了，衣服要少爷自己穿也就算了，现在竟然连少爷什么时候起床都摸不清楚了，不仅如此，更可气的是，在少爷受伤的时候，想多陪陪少爷，没想到竟然会趴在少爷身上睡着，而且居然还把少爷压醒了。想着这些，她竟也觉得自己有些可恨了起来，可能少爷也是觉得自己伺候的不好吧。

    原来月儿一如既往的在门外小声的指挥着下人们打扫庭院时，又一如昨日般的被喊进了屋内。

    “月儿姐，你看，我都已经好了，一点问题都没有了，你不要觉得胖子到现在都没起来，我就也起不来，我可跟你说，月儿姐，你家少爷我，那可是龙精虎猛，你信不信，少爷我一根手指头，能摁死十个胖子”贺峰一见月儿那快要哭出来的模样，心中立马急了起来，不停的显示着自己的强壮，还不断的摆着各种自以为很完美的姿势，说道：“你看，月儿姐，你看我”，完全满足了自己的显摆心理之后，才又走到月儿面前，接着说道：“看吧，我真的一点事都没有了，身上的伤已经都好了。”说着话，还不停的撸起袖子让月儿看。

    “知道啦，少爷，自己的身子，你可一定要当点儿紧”月儿轻轻地把贺峰刚撸起来的袖子又拉了下来。天这么冷，万一冻着了可了不得，月儿心想。

    贺峰哈哈笑了一声，便要出去开始晨练。在贺峰看来，晨练就像是跑马拉松，虽然跑一步两步没什么感觉，但要是能坚持跑下去的话，就会很明显的看到终点在慢慢地靠近。

    “二弟，背着我跑两圈呗？”不知道什么时候，原本应该在院中打扫的下人一个都没有了，而应该还在床上躺着的李纯却正坐在院中喝着茶。

    “大清早的喝的哪门子茶啊？我才不背你，压死人还要偿命，我是为你好”贺峰看了看自己的小身板儿，心想：被你跑两圈，还不如让我去跟金灿那几个娃子打一架来得舒服呢。
content_en:
Although my intuition tells me that having the same nightmare all the time is not a good sign, I still can't come up with any clue after thinking about it. What's more, even if it's not a good thing, hasn't it happened yet? There is no need to scare yourself about these insignificant things.

    It has to be said that sometimes what drives people forward is not always the famous sayings such as "Man can conquer nature". For example, the eldest son of our He family, the magic weapon for overcoming unknown difficulties is "There must be a road before the car reaches the mountain", "Soldiers will block it, water will come to the earth" and a series of aphorisms.

    After thinking about what should be thought about and putting aside what shouldn't be thought about, it was a long night and everything was quiet. For a young master, in this situation, he really couldn't think of anything to do without sleeping. However, fortunately, even though I had the same nightmare twice, I didn't have nightmares as soon as I fell asleep.

    There is no doubt that a good sleep can not only eliminate all the fatigue from yesterday, but also bring a good mood for the new day.

    "Master, you are still injured. Why did you get up so early?" Yue'er looked at the young master who was fully dressed with resentment. She pursed her lips and her face turned red. She felt that she was really becoming more and more incompetent. The young master had to wear his own clothes. Forget it, now I can't even figure out when the young master will get up. Not only that, but what's even more annoying is that when the young master was injured, he wanted to spend more time with the young master, but he didn't expect that he would fall asleep on the young master, and even press him to wake him up. Thinking about this, she actually felt a little hateful about herself. Maybe the young master also felt that he was not serving well.

    It turned out that Yue'er was quietly directing people to clean the courtyard outside the door as usual, when she was called into the house again just like yesterday.

    "Sister Yue'er, look, I'm already well. There's no problem at all. Don't think that because Fatty hasn't gotten up yet, I can't get up either. I'm telling you, Sister Yue'er, your young master and I are very powerful. Believe it or not, I can kill ten fat guys with one finger." When He Feng saw Yue'er looking like she was about to cry, he immediately became anxious. He kept showing off his strength, and kept doing various poses that he thought were perfect, and said: "Look, Sister Yue'er, look at me." After completely satisfying his need to show off, he walked up to Yue'er and continued: "Look, I'm really fine. All the injuries on my body have healed." As he spoke, he kept rolling up his sleeves for Yue'er to see.

    "I know, young master, you must be careful about your body." Yue'er gently pulled down He Feng's sleeves that he had just rolled up. It's so cold, it would be terrible if I get frozen, Yue'er thought to herself.

    He Feng laughed and went out to start morning exercises. In He Feng's view, morning exercise is like running a marathon. Although it doesn't feel like running one or two steps, if you can keep running, you will clearly see that the finish line is slowly approaching.

    "Second brother, why don't you carry me on your back and run around twice?" At some point, none of the servants who were supposed to be cleaning the courtyard were gone, but Li Chun, who should still be lying on the bed, was sitting in the courtyard drinking tea.

    "What kind of tea are you drinking so early in the morning? I won't carry you. I'll pay with my life if I crush someone. I'm doing this for your own good." He Feng looked at his small body and thought to himself: If you run around twice, it would be better for me to have a fight with Jin Can's kids.
title_en: Chapter 9: Morning exercise, that’s my secret
